results.name: Kettlebell Russian Twist
steps: Sit on the floor with your legs bent, knees together and feet raised slightly off the floor.

Starting on one side and sitting up straight with your core muscles engaged, lift the kettlebell off the floor with both hands and bring it across your body to the other side, rotating your chest towards the floor as you do so.
Tap the kettlebell lightly on the floor and bring the kettlebell back across your body to the starting position, rotating your chest towards the floor.
Repeat, keeping the legs bent and feet raised throughout the exercise.

results.name: Kettlebell Windmill
steps: Stand with feet slightly wider than shoulder width apart. Hold the kettlebell in one hand and extend your arm above your head.
Keeping your legs straight and the kettlebell above your head, lower the relaxed arm towards the ground, twisting your body towards the side of the raised arm.
Return to the starting potion, tilt your pelvis forward and repeat.

results.name: Kettlebell Situp
steps: Lay flat on your back with straight legs and hold the kettle bell above your chest at arms length.
Draw your belly into the base of your spine to engage the muscles, then raise your head and shoulders off the floor with the kettlebell raised at arms length above your chest.
Return to the starting position and repeat.

results.name: Kettlebell Larsen Press
steps: Start in a bench press position with your legs elevated. Try to keep your knees with a slight bend in them.
Lower kettlebells toward chest while keeping legs elevated and torso stable.
Press upward, squeezing chest at the top without arching lower back.

results.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Larsen Press
steps: Lie on bench with feet off floor, holding one kettlebell above chest.
Lower kettlebell toward chest while keeping core tight and legs raised.
Press upward, squeezing chest at the top without twisting torso.

results.name: Kettlebell Windmill Bottom Hand
steps: Stand with feet slightly wider than shoulder width apart. Hold the kettlebell in your bottom hand and extend the other arm above your head.
Keeping your legs straight and the kettlebell inside your thigh, lower the kettlebell towards the ground, twisting your body towards the side of the raised arm.
Return to the starting position, tilt your pelvis forward and repeat.

results.name: Kettlebell Front Rack Step Up
steps: Stand in front of a step or bench with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold kettlebells at your shoulders.
Step up onto the bench with your right foot, pushing off your foot to raise your body up onto the bench.

results.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Front Rack Step Up
steps: Stand in front of a step or bench with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a kettlebell at one shoulder.
Step up onto the bench with your right foot, pushing off your foot to raise your body up onto the bench.

results.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Front Rack Forward Lunge
steps: Hold kettlebell in front rack position.
Step forward, lunge. Bringing your back knee to the floor.
Extend your knee and return to the starting position.

results.name: Kettlebell Front Rack Squat
steps: Hold kettlebells close to chest.
Squat down, keeping chest up.
Stand up, extending hips fully.

results.name: Kettlebell Front Rack Single Arm Lateral Lunge
steps: Hold kettlebell in front rack.
Step sideways, lunge.

results.name: Kettlebell Front Rack Reverse Lunge (Double)
steps: Start with kettlebell in front rack.
Step back into lunge.
Return to start position.

results.name: Kettlebell Front Rack Lateral Lunge (Double)
steps: Hold kettlebell in front rack.
Step sideways into a lunge position.
Return to start position. Repeat.

results.name: Kettlebell Front Rack Forward Lunge (Double)
steps: Start with kettlebells in front rack.
Step forward into lunge.
Return to starting position.

results.name: Kettlebell Front Rack Curtsy Lunge (Double)
steps: Hold kettlebells in front rack.
Step back and lunge diagonally.

results.name: Kettlebell Hollow Hold
steps: Grab a kettlebell.
Lie on your back, lift legs & shoulders off floor.
Hold kettlebell above your head, engage core, and maintain position.

results.name: Kettlebell Goblet Curl
steps: Stand up straight with a kettlebell in both hands in front of your pelvis.
Raise the kettlebell bending your arms at the elbow until the kettlebell is level with your chest.
Lower to the starting position and repeat.

results.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Curl
steps: Stand up straight with a kettlebell in one hand with your forearm facing out.
Raise the kettlebell, bending your arm at the elbow and keeping your forearm vertical until your palm faces the shoulder.
Lower to the starting position and repeat.

results.name: Kettlebell Preacher Curl
steps: Stand behind a bench, with your chest leaning over the edge of the bench.
With one arm resting on the bench, hold the kettlebell, bending the arm at the elbow.
Lower your arm using the bench as a guide, keeping your forearm straight.
Return to the starting position and repeat.

results.name: Kettlebell Concentration Curl
steps: Sitting on a chair with your legs apart, rest your arm against your thigh and hold the kettlebell with your arm extended towards the floor.
Bending your arm at the elbow, lift the kettlebell until your palm faces your shoulder.
Lower to the starting position and repeat.

results.name: Kettlebell Row (Single)
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart holding the kettlebell with both hands in front of your thighs.
Bend forward at the hips bringing the kettlebell to the floor while you slightly bend your knees, keeping your back straight.
Lift the kettlebell upwards towards your chest and lower - repeat.

results.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Row
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart, shifting one foot behind you. Hold the kettlebell in the same hand as the leg shifted backwards.
Bend forwards at the hips bringing the kettlebell to the floor while you slightly bend your knee, keeping your back straight.
Lift the kettlebell upwards towards your chest and lower - repeat.

results.name: Kettlebell Rear Delt Row
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart, holding the kettlebell with both hands in front of your thighs.
Bend forward at the hips bringing the kettlebell to the floor while you slightly bend your knees, keeping your back straight.
Lift the kettlebell upwards towards your upper chest and then lower the kettlebell- repeat.

results.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Pendlay Row
steps: Stand with feet hip-width, hinge forward until torso is nearly parallel to floor.
Pick kettlebell from ground with straight arm, keeping back flat and core braced.
Pull elbow straight up to ribs, then lower kettlebell fully back to floor each rep.

results.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Rear Delt Row
steps: Hinge at hips with back flat, holding kettlebell under shoulder.
Pull elbow out and back at a wide angle, targeting rear delt.
Squeeze at the top, then lower slowly to full stretch.

results.name: Kettlebell Drag Curl
steps: Grab two kettlebells with an underhand grip.
Pull your elbows straight back and let the kettlebells drag against your upper body (or very close to it).

results.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Row On Bench
steps: Start by standing in front of a flat bench with your feet shoulder-width apart and holding a kettlebell in one hand.
Place your other hand on the bench for support, and bend at the waist so that your chest is parallel to the ground.
From this starting position, row the kettlebell up towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blade together as you do so.
Make sure to keep your elbow close to your body and your core engaged throughout the movement.

results.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Reverse Curl
steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart.
Hold a kettlebell with palms facing down.
Lift kettlebell toward shoulders, squeezing biceps, then lower with control.

results.name: Kettlebell Row
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, hold a kettlebell in each hand.
Hinge at hips, keep back straight, and pull both kettlebells to hips.

results.name: Kettlebell Reverse Curl
steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart.
Hold kettlebell with palms facing down.
Lift kettlebell toward shoulders, squeezing biceps, then lower with control.

results.name: Kettlebell Rear Delt Row (Double)
steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart, kettlebell in each hand, hinge at hips.
Pull kettlebells while flaring your elbows, squeezing shoulder blades. Keep back flat.

results.name: Kettlebell Gorilla Row
steps: Stand with kettlebell between legs.
Hinge at hips, grab kettlebell, pull to chest and rotate at the torso

results.name: Kettlebell Calf Raise
steps: Standing straight with a kettlebell in each hand, raise your heels upwards while keeping your knees stationary.
Pause when your heels are fully extended and then slowly return to the starting position and repeat.

results.name: Kettlebell Single Leg Calf Raise
steps: Standing straight with a kettlebell in one hand, lift the same foot as the side without the kettlebell off the floor.
Raise your heel upwards while keeping your knees stationary.
Pause when your heels are fully extended and then slowly return to the starting position and repeat.

results.name: Kettlebell Seated Calf Raise
steps: Sitting comfortably on a chair with your core stomach muscles engaged, place your feet on the floor.
Place the kettlebell on your legs, just above the knees and raise your heels upwards off the floor.
Pause when your heels are fully extended and then slowly return to the starting position and repeat.

results.name: Kettlebell Goblet Calf Raise
steps: Standing straight with a kettlebell in a goblet position, raise your heels upwards while keeping your knees stationary.
Pause when your heels are fully extended and then slowly return to the starting position and repeat.

results.name: Kettlebell Seated Calf Raise Double
steps: Start by sitting on a bench with a barbell resting on your knees. Your feet should be flat on the ground, about hip-width apart.
Place your hands on the barbell for support, and lift your heels off the ground.
Hold this position for a moment, then slowly lower your heels back to the ground.

results.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Calf Raise
steps: Stand tall with your feet on the ground. You can put the the balls of your feet on top of a plate to extend the range of motion.
Imagine you have a string attached to your heels and pull your heels up toward the ceiling.

results.name: Kettlebell Single Leg Single Arm Calf Raise
steps: Standing straight with a kettlebell in one hand, lift the opposing foot off the floor.
Raise your heel upwards while keeping your knees stationary.
Pause when your heels are fully extended and then slowly return to the starting position and repeat.

results.name: Kettlebell Chest Press (Single)
steps: Laying on the floor with your knees bent and feet firmly on the floor, hold the kettlebell at your chest with both hands.
Fully extend your arms, raising the kettlebell until your elbows are locked.
Lower the kettlebell to the starting position and repeat.

results.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Press
steps: Laying on the floor with your knees bent and feet firmly on the floor, leave one arm resting to the side of the body.
Using the other arm, hold the kettlebell at arms length directly upwards of your shoulder.
Lower your arm until your upper arm to elbow is resting on the floor.
Return to starting position.

results.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Chest Fly
steps: Lie on the floor with your knees bent and feet firmly on the floor, with your arms to the side of your body.
Holding a kettlebell in one hand, keeping your arm fully extended with a slight bend in the elbow and your forearms facing upwards, lift the kettlebell above your chest.
Lower the kettlebell to the starting position and repeat.

results.name: Kettlebell Walkover Pushup
steps: Starting in a press up position with feet wide and one hand resting on the kettlebell, complete a full press up, lowering your chest towards the ground while keeping your body straight and returning to the starting position.
Swap hands on the kettlebell, placing the hand originally on the kettlebell underneath your shoulder, complete another press up.
Repeat.

results.name: Kettlebell Floor Fly
steps: Lie on your back holding kettlebells above chest with slight elbow bend.
Lower arms out wide until elbows lightly touch the floor.
Bring kettlebells back together over chest, squeezing pecs at the top.

results.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Floor Fly
steps: Lie on your back holding one kettlebell above chest with slight elbow bend.
Lower arm out wide until elbow lightly touches the floor.
Bring kettlebell back over chest, squeezing pec at the top.

results.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Chest Press
steps: Lie on bench holding one kettlebell above chest with arm extended.
Lower kettlebell toward chest while keeping torso stable.
Press upward, squeezing chest at the top without twisting.

results.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Incline Chest Press
steps: Sit on incline bench holding kettlebell at shoulder with elbow bent.
Press kettlebell upward and slightly inward until arm fully extends.
Lower slowly to starting position, keeping torso stable and controlled.

results.name: Kettlebell Single Arm High Incline Chest Press
steps: Sit on high incline bench holding kettlebell at shoulder height.
Press kettlebell upward and slightly inward until arm fully extends.
Lower slowly to start position, keeping torso stable and controlled.

results.name: Kettlebell Incline Guillotine Bench Press
steps: Lie on bench, hold kettlebell with both hands over chest.
Lower kettlebells, elbows flared.
Press kettlebells upward, fully extending arms. Repeat.

results.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Floor Press
steps: Start flat on your back with a kettlebell extended over you.
Bring your elbow to the floor, rest for a second to remove all the momentum from the rep, then press to a lockout.

results.name: Kettlebell Floor Press
steps: Start flat on your back with the kettlebells extended over you.
Bring your elbows to the floor, rest for a second to remove all the momentum from the rep, then press to a lockout.

results.name: Kettlebell Incline Bench Press
steps: Position the bench between
and
degrees.
Lay flat on the bench with your feet on the ground.
Lower the kettlebells to your mid chest
Raise the kettlebells (slowly and controlled) until you've locked your elbows.

results.name: Kettlebell High Incline Bench Press
steps: Position the bench between
and
degrees.
Lay flat on the bench with your feet on the ground.
Lower the kettlebells to your mid chest
Raise the kettlebells (slowly and controlled) until you've locked your elbows.

results.name: Kettlebell Farmers Carry
steps: Hold two kettlebells in each hand.
Keep your shoulders blades pulled back and walk for a specified duration.

results.name: Kettlebell Wrist Curl
steps: Stand up straight with a kettlebell in both hands in front of your pelvis, with your forearms facing outwards.
Flex your wrist towards your body until the kettlebell is level with your stomach.
Lower to the starting position and repeat.

results.name: Kettlebell Wrist Extension
steps: Stand up straight with a kettlebell in both hands in front of your pelvis, with your forearms facing inwards.
Flex your wrist upwards until wrists are fully extended.
Lower to the starting position and repeat.

results.name: Kettlebell Bench Wrist Curl
steps: Grip the kettlebells with your palm facing upwards with your forearm rested against the bench.
Slowly curl your wrist upwards in a semicircular motion.
Return to starting position and repeat.

results.name: Kettlebell Farmers March
steps: Stand tall holding two kettlebells in each hand.
March in place for the desired amount of reps or time.

results.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Farmers March
steps: Standing straight with a kettlebell in one hand, lift the knee of one leg off the floor to knee height.
Bring the leg back to standing and repeat with the other leg, keeping the kettlebell on the same side.
Repeat.

results.name: Kettlebell Walking Farmers March
steps: Standing straight with kettlebells, start walking towards a set point. Pulling your knee up toward the ceiling.
Make sure to keep your chest tall and shoulder blades pulled back.
Try to keep your stride distance roughly the same.

results.name: Kettlebell Alternating Row
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, kettlebell in one hand.
Bend at hips, row kettlebell to chest.
Alternate hands for each row.

results.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Farmers Walk
steps: Standing straight with a kettlebell in one hand, walk for a specified distance or duration.
Stay upright and don't lean to one side.

results.name: Kettlebell Upright Row
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart holding the kettlebell with both hands in front of your thighs.
Bend forward at the hips bringing the kettlebell to the floor while you slightly bend your knees, keeping your back straight.
Lift the kettlebell upwards towards your chest and lower - repeat.

results.name: Kettlebell Front Raise
steps: Stand up straight with feet shoulder width apart, holding the kettlebell in front of your pelvis.
Keeping arms straight, raise the kettlebell slightly higher than head level.
Return to the starting position and repeat.

results.name: Kettlebell Long Lever Lateral Raise
steps: Stand with feet shoulder width apart holding a kettlebell with one hand at your side.
Keeping your arm straight, swing the kettlebell up and out, away from your body to around head height, holding on to the kettlebell firmly so it does not change position in your hand.
Return to the starting position and repeat.

results.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Hang Clean And Press
steps: Hold kettlebell just above knee with slight bend in hips and knees.
Explosively pull kettlebell to shoulder, catching it in a partial squat.
Stand tall and press kettlebell overhead until arm is fully extended.

results.name: Kettlebell Thruster
steps: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart and holding a kettlebell in each hand.
Bring the kettlebells to your shoulders, with your palms facing inward and your elbows bent.
From this starting position, dip your knees slightly and then quickly extend them as you press the kettlebells upwards.
As you press the kettlebells upwards, also push your hips forward to help generate additional power.
Slowly lower the kettlebells back down to the starting position, and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

results.name: Kettlebell Squat Clean And Jerk
steps: Start with kettlebells between legs resting on the floor with knee bend and flat back.
Pull kettlebells explosively to shoulder, catching it in a squat position.
Stand tall, dip slightly, then drive up to press kettlebells overhead.

results.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Thruster
steps: Hold kettlebell at shoulder height with feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down, then drive upward, pressing kettlebell overhead in one motion.
Lower kettlebell as you descend into next rep smoothly.

results.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Push Press
steps: Hold kettlebell at shoulder height, feet shoulder-width apart.
Dip slightly at knees, then drive upward, pressing kettlebell overhead.
Lock out arm briefly, then lower kettlebell under control.

results.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Hang Clean And Jerk
steps: Hold kettlebell in one hand at thigh level with slight knee bend.
Pull kettlebell explosively to shoulder, catching it in rack position.
Dip slightly, then drive upward to press kettlebell overhead.

results.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Clean And Jerk
steps: Hold kettlebell between legs with one hand, hinge slightly at hips.
Pull kettlebell upward to shoulder, catching it in rack position.
Dip at knees, then drive upward to press kettlebell overhead.

results.name: Kettlebell Hang Squat Clean And Jerk
steps: Hold kettlebell between legs with slight knee bend and flat back.
Pull kettlebell explosively to shoulder, catching it in a squat position.
Stand tall, dip slightly, then drive up to press kettlebell overhead.

results.name: Kettlebell Hang Clean And Jerk
steps: Hold kettlebells just above knees with slight bend in hips and knees.
Explosively pull kettlebells to shoulders, catching it in a partial squat.
Stand tall and press kettlebells overhead until arms are fully extended.

results.name: Kettlebell Clean And Jerk
steps: Swing kettlebell between legs, then pull it up to rack position.
Dip slightly, drive through legs, and press kettlebell overhead.
Lower back to rack, then swing down for next repetition.

results.name: Kettlebell Alternating Single Arm Thruster
steps: Hold two kettlebells at shoulder height, palms facing inward.
Squat down, then drive upward, pressing both kettlebells overhead.
Lower kettlebells as you descend again, alternating arms each rep.

results.name: Kettlebell Hang Clean And Press
steps: Hold kettlebells just above knees with slight bend in hips and knees.
Explosively pull kettlebells to shoulders, catching it in a partial squat.
Stand tall and press kettlebells overhead until arms are fully extended.

results.name: Kettlebell Kneeling Bottoms Up Overhead Press
steps: Start by taking a kneeling position and holding a kettlebell in each hand with the bottom of the kettlebell facing up.
Bring the kettlebells to your shoulders, with your palms facing forward and your elbows bent.
From this starting position, extend your arms upwards so that the kettlebells are overhead.
Make sure to keep your core engaged and your back straight throughout the movement.

results.name: Kettlebell Bottoms Up Single Arm Overhead Press
steps: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart and holding one kettlebell with the bottom of the kettlebell facing up.
Bring the kettlebell to your shoulders, with your palms facing forward and your elbows bent.
From this starting position, extend your arms upwards so that the kettlebell are overhead.
Make sure to keep your core engaged and your back straight throughout the movement.

results.name: Kettlebell Bottoms Up Overhead Press
steps: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart and holding a kettlebell in each hand with the bottom of the kettlebell facing up.
Bring the kettlebells to your shoulders, with your palms facing forward and your elbows bent.
From this starting position, extend your arms upwards so that the kettlebells are overhead.
Make sure to keep your core engaged and your back straight throughout the movement.

results.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Forward Lunge
steps: Stand straight with your feet slightly apart and hold a kettlebell in one hand.
Bring the same leg as the arm holding the kettlebell in front of you, squat down until your thigh is parallel to the ground, keeping your back straight.
Return to the starting position and repeat.

results.name: Kettlebell Step Up
steps: Standing up straight, using a bench as a step, raise one foot onto the bench and hold the kettlebell in the same arm as the straight leg.
Stand and bring both feet onto the bench. Slowly lower your leg back down to the starting position.
Repeat.

results.name: Kettlebell Hip Thrust
steps: Sitting on the floor with your knees bent and feet planted firmly on the floor, lean your back against the bench.
Resting the kettlebell on your pelvis, raise your pelvis until your stomach, pelvis and thighs are in line.
Slowly lower until you are in the starting position and repeat.

results.name: Kettlebell Goblet Squat
steps: Hold the weight tucked into your upper chest area, keeping your elbows in. Your feet should be slightly wider than your shoulders.
Sink down into the squat, keeping your elbows inside the track of your knees.
Push through your heels while keeping your chest up and return to the starting position.

results.name: Kettlebell Staggered Deadlift (Single)
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart, shifting one foot behind you. Hold the kettlebell in both hands in front of your thighs.
Bend forward at the hips bringing the kettlebell to the floor while you slightly bend your knees and keep your back straight.
Return to the upright position and repeat.

results.name: Kettlebell Swing
steps: Stand with your feet slightly wider than shoulder width apart holding the kettlebell between your legs, with your knees slightly bent.
Keeping your back straight, swing the kettlebell upwards until the kettlebell is level with your chest and carefully lower.
Repeat

results.name: Kettlebell Lateral Lunge (Single)
steps: Stand straight with your feet shoulder width apart. Keep your back straight and hold the kettlebell in front of your pelvis.
Take a large step to one side, holding the kettlebell low and lunge into the bent leg.
Return to the starting position and repeat

results.name: Kettlebell Goblet Good Morning
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart holding the kettlebell with both hands in front of your chest.
Bend forward at the hips keeping your back and knees straight and the kettlebell close to your chest.
Return to standing position and thrust your pelvis forward.

results.name: Kettlebell Single Leg Deadlift
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart, lifting one foot off the floor behind you. Hold the kettlebell in the same arm as the lifted leg.
Bend forward at the hips bringing the kettlebell to the floor while you extend your lifted leg behind you, keeping your back straight - holding out your arm to the side for balance.
Return to the upright position and repeat.

results.name: Kettlebell Glute Bridge
steps: Laying on the floor with your knees bent and feet firmly on the floor, rest the kettlebell on your pelvis.
Pushing through the legs and keeping the core muscles engaged, raise your pelvis off the floor until your stomach, pelvis and thighs make a straight line.
Slowly lower to the ground to the starting position and repeat.

results.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Reverse Lunge
steps: Stand straight with your feet slightly apart and hold a kettlebell in one hand.
Bring the same leg as the arm holding the kettlebell behind you, squat down until your back knee touches the ground, keeping your back straight.
Return to the starting position and repeat.

results.name: Kettlebell Heels Up Goblet Squat
steps: Hold the weight tucked into your upper chest area, keeping your elbows in. Your feet should be slightly wider than your shoulders and the heels slightly raised on a surface.
Sink down into the squat, keeping your elbows inside the track of your knees.
Push through your heels while keeping your chest up and return to the starting position.

results.name: Kettlebell Single Leg Glute Bridge
steps: Laying on the floor with one knee bent with the foot firmly on the floor and one leg extended, rest the kettlebell on your pelvis.
Pushing through the bent leg and keeping the core muscles engaged, raise your pelvis and the extended leg off the floor until your stomach, pelvis and thighs make a straight line.
Slowly lower to the ground to the starting position and repeat.

results.name: Kettlebell Single Leg Hip Thrust
steps: Sitting on the floor with one knee bent with the foot firmly on the floor and one leg extended, lean your back against the bench.
Resting the kettlebell on your pelvis, raise your pelvis until your stomach, pelvis and thighs are in line.
Slowly lower until you are in the starting position and repeat.

results.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Step Up Knee Drive
steps: Hold one kettlebell at your side and place opposite foot on platform.
Drive through front heel to step up, keeping torso tall and core tight.
Lift trailing knee high at the top, then step down slowly with control.

results.name: Kettlebell Conventional Deadlift (Double)
steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart.
Bend at hips and knees to lift kettlebells.
Stand tall, then lower.

results.name: Kettlebell Snatch (Double)
steps: Begin with a two kettlebells between your legs, hinge at hips, then swing it upwards explosively.
As they rise, lock out arm overhead, wrist straight.
Control the descent, then repeat.

results.name: Kettlebell Swing (Double)
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, kettlebells outside legs
Hinge at hips, swing kettlebells forward, then back.
Thrust hips to swing kettlebells upward, keeping arms straight.

results.name: Kettlebell Figure Four Hip Thrust
steps: Begin seated, kettlebell on hips.
Lift hips, form figure four leg shape.
Lower, repeat thrusts.

results.name: Kettlebell Forward Lunge (Double)
steps: Hold kettlebell at your side.
Step forward, lunge, and return.
Repeat with opposite leg.

results.name: Kettlebell Full Swing
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, kettlebell between legs.
Hinge at hips, grip kettlebell, and swing it overhead.
Extend hips and knees, lock out arms at the top.

results.name: Kettlebell Lateral Lunge
steps: Hold kettlebells in front of you.
Step sideways, lunge down and let the kettlebells land between your legs.
Push off, return to start. Repeat.

results.name: Kettlebell Reverse Lunge
steps: Hold kettlebells at your side.
Step backward, lower body.

results.name: Kettlebell Romanian Deadlift
steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart, holding kettlebells in front.
Hinge at hips, keeping back straight, and lower kettlebells towards ground.
Return to start position, squeezing glutes at the top.

results.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Clean And Press
steps: Begin with the kettlebell between your legs.
Hinge at your hips, and lift to shoulder, then press overhead.

results.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Curtsy Lunge
steps: Hold kettlebell in one hand.
Step back, left leg behind right.
Return to start position. Repeat.

results.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Front Rack Reverse Lunge
steps: Hold kettlebell in front rack position.
Step backward, lunge. Bring your back knee to the floor.
Extend your knee back into the starting position.

results.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Snatch
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, kettlebell between legs.
Squat, grip kettlebell, explode hips, and lift kettlebell overhead.
Lower kettlebell safely to start position.

results.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Swing
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, kettlebell between legs, grip with one hand, hinge at hips.
Swing kettlebell forcefully forward, using hip thrust, arm straight.
Swing kettlebell back between legs, repeat for desired reps.

results.name: Kettlebell Staggered Deadlift
steps: Begin with feet hip-width apart, one foot forward, kettlebell between feet.
Hinge at hips, grip kettlebell, and stand tall.
Lower kettlebell with control, then repeat.

results.name: Kettlebell Staggered Swing
steps: Lower kettlebell with control, then repeat.
Explosively thrust hips forward, swing kettlebell to chest height.
Repeat for desired reps, keeping core engaged and maintaining a staggered stance for balance.

results.name: Kettlebell Sumo Deadlift
steps: Stand with feet wide apart, toes pointing slightly outward, and kettlebell on the floor between your feet.
Bend at hips and knees, keeping back straight, and grip the kettlebell handle.
Lift the kettlebell by extending hips and knees, stand up straight, and return to the starting position.

results.name: Swing To Upright Row
steps: Start with a kettlebell between your legs, hinge at hips, swing it upward.
Lift kettlebell to chest level, elbows high, engaging shoulders.
Lower kettlebell back down, maintaining control. Repeat for desired reps.

results.name: Kettlebell Step Up Double
steps: Standing up straight, using a bench as a step, raise one foot onto the bench and hold the kettlebell in the same arm as the straight leg.
Stand and bring both feet onto the bench. Slowly lower your leg back down to the starting position.
Repeat.

results.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Step Up Balance
steps: Begin by standing in front of a sturdy box or bench that is about knee-height, holding a kettlebell in one hand
Place your right foot on the box and push through the heel to lift your body up and onto the box, keeping your left foot off the ground.
Step back down with your right foot, lowering your left foot to the ground.

results.name: Kettlebell Suitcase Deadlift
steps: Begin by standing with your feet hip-width apart and holding a kettlebell at one side of your body, with your palms facing your thighs.
Keeping your core engaged and your back straight, bend at the hips and knees to lower the kettlebell down towards the ground.
As the kettlebell reaches the ground, use your legs and glutes to push through your heels and extend your hips and knees to raise your body back to the starting position.
Repeat the movement for the desired number of reps, then switch sides and repeat the exercise with the kettlebell on the opposite side of your body.

results.name: Kettlebell Box Squat
steps: Stand in front of a box or bench with your feet shoulder-width apart with a kettlebell in a goblet position.
Lower your body into a squat position, sitting back onto the box and pausing for a moment before standing back up.
Push through your heels to return to the standing position.

results.name: Kettlebell Kickstand Squat
steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart, one foot slightly behind. Hold kettlebell in a goblet position.
Lower into a squat, keeping weight on front heel.
Return to standing, engaging glutes and core.

results.name: Kettlebell Swing Lunge
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width. Kettlebell at your side.
Step forward with your right foot and bend both knees to lower your body until your right thigh is parallel to the ground.
Push off your right foot to return to the starting position.
Step back with the same leg until the back knee taps the floor.

results.name: Kettlebell Alternating Curtsy Lunge
steps: Hold a kettlebell at your chest, feet hip-width apart.
Step one leg diagonally back into a lunge.
Alternate legs, keeping your chest up and core engaged.

results.name: Kettlebell Alternating Lateral Lunge
steps: Hold one kettlebell with one or both hands, feet hip-width apart.
Step out to one side, bending the knee.
Push off, return to center, then switch sides.

results.name: Kettlebell Alternating Reverse Lunge
steps: Hold two kettlebells by your side.
Take a big step backwards with your left leg, lowering your body until your left thigh is parallel to the ground and your right knee is bent at a 90-degree angle.
Push back up and switch legs, alternating each rep.

results.name: Kettlebell Alternating Forward Lunge
steps: Stand tall, holding kettlebells by your sides, feet hip-width apart.
Step forward with one leg, lowering until both knees form 90° angles.
Push through front foot, return to start, and switch legs.

results.name: Kettlebell Assisted Bulgarian Split Squat
steps: Grab a stick of some sort or hold onto something stable (rack, bench).
Grab a box that is knee height or slightly lower.
Hold the stick in your right arm, kettlebell in the other and put your right leg on the box.
Begin your squat by breaking at the knees. Get your knee close to the floor or all the way to the floor. Make sure to keep your chest tall.

results.name: Kettlebell Front Rack Deficit Reverse Lunge
steps: Stand on a platform, kettlebells in front rack position, feet hip-width apart.
Step back, lowering knee toward floor, keeping chest upright and core engaged.
Push through front foot, return to start.

results.name: Kettlebell Staggered Waiters Bow
steps: Set up a bar at mid way up your quad. Place the working leg against the bar.
Place one foot behind. You should only be on your toes on that back foot. Your front foot should be planted flat the entire time.
Bend your back knee and push your hips back. Look for a stretch in your front hamstring.
When you feel the stretch, push your hips forward again until you're back in a standing position.

results.name: Kettlebell Deficit Reverse Lunge
steps: Stand on a platform, kettlebells in each hand, feet hip-width apart.
Step back, lowering knee toward floor, keeping chest upright and core engaged.
Push through front foot, return to start.

results.name: Kettlebell Waiters Bow
steps: Place a barbell at about midway up your thigh. Press your quads into the barbell.
Push your hips back while leaving your knees mostly extended. Look for a stretch in your hamstrings.
When you feel the stretch, push your hips forward until you're back in a standing position.

results.name: Kettlebell Quad Stomp
steps: Place your foot on a plate or a low box. Hold two kettlebells in each hand.
Put all of your weight on your front foot and lean forward.
Lower until your calves touch your hamstrings and then extend back up.

results.name: Kettlebell Half Kneeling Romanian Deadlift
steps: Place one knee on a bench and hold a kettlebell.
Push your hips back while leaving your knee mostly extended. Look for a stretch in your hamstrings.
When you feel the stretch, push your hips forward until you're back in a standing position.

results.name: Kettlebell Half Kneeling Goblet Romanian Deadlift
steps: Place one knee on a bench and hold a kettlebell in a goblet position.
Push your hips back while leaving your knee mostly extended. Look for a stretch in your hamstrings.
When you feel the stretch, push your hips forward until you're back in a standing position.

results.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Front Rack Step Up Knee Drive
steps: Hold kettlebell in front rack position and place opposite foot on platform.
Drive through front heel to step up while keeping chest tall and stable.
Lift trailing knee high at the top, then step down slowly with control.

results.name: Kettlebell Front Rack Step Up Knee Drive
steps: Hold kettlebells in front rack position and place one foot on platform.
Drive through front heel to step up, keeping chest tall and core tight.
Lift trailing knee high at the top, then step down slowly with control.

results.name: Kettlebell Deadlift (Single)
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart holding the kettlebell with both hands in front of your thighs.
Bend forward at the hips bringing the kettlebell to the floor while you slightly bend your knees, keeping your back straight.
Return to standing position and repeat.

results.name: Kettlebell Pullover
steps: Rest your upper back on the bench and place soles of your feet firmly on the floor keeping torso and thighs suspended and parallel to the floor.
Hold the kettlebell with both hands above your chest, keeping your arms straight.
Keeping your arms straight, move the kettlebell in the direction of your head until your arms are parallel to the floor.
Return to starting to position and repeat.

results.name: Kettlebell Shoulder Extension
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart bending forward at the hips as far as comfortable. Place off-hand on the same side thigh for stability.
Hold the kettlebell in one hand, straight armed and pointing towards the floor.
Keeping your arm straight, swing the kettlebell behind you as far as comfortable.
Return to the starting position and repeat.

results.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Pullover
steps: Lie on bench holding one kettlebell above chest with slight elbow bend.
Lower kettlebell in an arc behind head until you feel a deep stretch.
Pull kettlebell back over chest using lats and triceps, keeping control.

results.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Shoulder Extension
steps: Hold kettlebell at your sides with straight arms and palms neutral.
Move arm backward until you feel lats and rear delts engage.
Lower slowly to starting position under full control.

results.name: Kettlebell Spinal Jefferson Curl
steps: Stand tall holding kettlebells in front with feet hip-width apart.
Slowly roll down through spine one vertebra at a time, reaching toward toes.
Reverse the motion, rolling up through spine until standing tall again.

results.name: Kettlebell Wood Chopper
steps: Stand with feet slightly wider than shoulder width apart and hold the kettle bell with both hands against your hip.
Keeping your arms straight, swing the kettlebell upwards and across your body towards your shoulder, raising the kettlebell to head height rotating your hips as you do so.
Return to the starting position and repeat.

results.name: Kettlebell Somersault Squat
steps: Start in a deep squat holding a kettlebell between your thighs.
Extend your knees until mostly extended without extending the hips.

results.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Rear Delt Fly
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart holding the kettlebell with both hands in front of your thighs.
Bend forward at the hips bringing the kettlebell to the floor while you slightly bend your knees, keeping your back straight.
Bring one arm behind you and rest this arm on your back. With the other arm, hold the kettlebell at arms length close to the floor.
Swing the kettlebell out and up towards the side of your body and then return to centre. Repeat.

results.name: Kettlebell Incline Shrug
steps: Leaning across the back section of the bench, with feet firmly on the floor and with arms hanging to the sides.
Holding the kettlebell in both hands engage your shoulder blades, as if you are trying to touch them together. Release the shrug.

results.name: Kettlebell Silverback Shrug (Single)
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart holding the kettlebell with both hands in front of your thighs.
Bend forward at the hips bringing the kettlebell to the floor while you slightly bend your knees, keeping your back straight.
Holding the kettlebell in both hands engage your shoulder blades, as if you are trying to touch them together. Release the shrug.

results.name: Kettlebell Shrug (Single)
steps: Standing up straight with feet shoulder width apart.
Holding the kettlebell in both hands in front of your pelvis, engage your shoulder blades, as if you are trying to touch them together.
Release the shrug and repeat

results.name: Kettlebell Shrug
steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart, hold one kettlebell in each hand at your sides.
Lift your shoulders upward while keeping arms straight.
Lower shoulders back down, repeat for desired reps.

results.name: Kettlebell Upright Row Single
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart holding the kettlebell with both hands in front of your thighs.
Bend forward at the hips bringing the kettlebell to the floor while you slightly bend your knees, keeping your back straight.
Lift the kettlebell upwards towards your chest and lower - repeat.

results.name: Kettlebell Silverback Shrug
steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart, hold one kettlebell in each hand at your sides, and lean forward.
Lift your shoulders backward while keeping arms straight.
Lower shoulders back down, repeat for desired reps.

results.name: Kettlebell Tate Press
steps: Lie flat on your back. Keeping your arm straight, hold the kettlebell above your chest with your palm facing away from your body.
Bend your arm, touching the kettlebell to the top of the shoulder opposite to the arm being worked.
Return to the starting position and repeat.

results.name: Kettlebell Decline Skull Crusher
steps: Lie on the floor with your upper back and soles of feet on the floor, knees bent, and pelvis and lower back suspended in the air.
Hold the kettlebell in both hands directly above your chest.
Keeping your upper arms in place, bend your elbows to bring the kettlebell to the floor above your head.
Return the kettlebell to the starting position and repeat.

results.name: Kettlebell Standing Tricep Extension
steps: Stand with legs shoulder width apart.
Hold the kettlebell in both hands behind your head.
Straighten arms bringing kettlebell above your head.
Return to the starting position and repeat.

results.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Tricep Guilotine Press
steps: Lie on bench holding kettlebell above upper chest with palm facing in.
Lower kettlebell toward neck or upper chest by bending elbow forward.
Extend arm fully, squeezing triceps at the top while keeping shoulder stable.

results.name: Kettlebell Overhead Tricep Extension
steps: Be careful getting the KB into place overhead. Push your elbows forward while keeping your elbows tucked in.
Look for what feels like a stretch in your triceps. Extend your elbows until your fists are pointed at the ceiling.
